notes.title: Major update
notes.notes:
This update (v0.99) is live now. The ladder has been reset.

[list]
[*] Added Town Portal functionality
[*] Revised the campaign to be more linear
[*] Areas no longer have to be unleashed
[*] Life leech now works with multiple damage instances
[*] Removed 7 skills that were rarely used
[*] 15 new skills
[*] 2 new unique items
[*] Over 20 buffed skills
[*] 2 nerfed skills
[*] Stand-alone client will no longer work. Players must use Steam.
[*] Bug fixes
[/list]

Full change log:
https://www.dropbox.com/s/g8deyhsrg73c2an/Changelog.txt?dl=0

notes.title: Major update: Version 0.92 releases July 18th, 2022 at 15:00 GMT
notes.notes:
All ladder characters will be moved to non-ladder and a new ladder season begins.

New features:
[list]
[*]In-game loot filter UI
[*]The main quest is now longer and there is further difficulty after the main quest
[*]Beacons now reset the whole area, respawning all monsters
[*]The Ancient, a new end boss that droms Pure items
[*]More than 20 new skills
[*]Improved balance. In particular, poison, minions and healing require more investment now.
[*]Visual improvements
[*]Bug fixes
[/list]

Full change log:
https://www.dropbox.com/s/g8deyhsrg73c2an/Changelog.txt?dl=0

notes.title: Major update
notes.notes:
The full change log is here:
https://www.dropbox.com/s/g8deyhsrg73c2an/Changelog.txt?dl=0

The update will be released December 28th ad 14:00 GMT.

The ladder will be reset. Current ladder characters will become non-ladder characters and the new ladder begins from scratch.

We are retiring the competitive aspect of ladder resets. There is no longer any reward associated with winning the ladder. Just play for fun!

notes.title: Edge of Existence (update 0.40) released today
notes.notes:
Three months after release, we are announcing a content update.

This update introduces a new town, Lansarot, which is a demiplane attached to Wormhole, making it a perfect outpost for planar travel. The areas south of Lansarot lead further out in the multiverse, all the way to and beyond the Edge of Existence where the Border Spinner and Border Eater fight an eternal battle.

A new class: Sorcerer. It is a master of elements, able to change how elements work.

More variation: We've added spike traps, natural hazards, random events and more varied special mobs.

Three new unique items, each enabling a new type of build.

Various quality of life improvements such as stackable orbs.

Shapechanging revision: No shapeshifts are buffs anymore. All shapeshifts override certain stats. Many shapes change size with skill level. You can become a T Rex if you max out Dinosaur Shape.

And the usual: Bug fixes, balance changes, tooltip fixes etc.

A full change log can be found here:
https://www.dropbox.com/s/g8deyhsrg73c2an/Changelog.txt?dl=0
